title: MEATER Target Temperature Undershoot
app: Meater probes, Anova Precision Cooker sessions, Instant Pot logs, wine-fridge sensors, ESPHome kitchen sensors, and pantry inventory feeds via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=meater:cook
| eval undershoot_c=target_temp_c-finish_temp_c
| where undershoot_c>3
| stats avg(undershoot_c) as avg_undershoot_c by protein
| sort - avg_undershoot_c
description: Uses MEATER finish temperatures telemetry to monitor how far final temperature finished below target in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for proteins that keep landing underdone, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest MEATER finish temperatures data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how far final temperature finished below target so you can spot proteins that keep landing underdone before it becomes annoying.
